sections.title: Working on
sections.text: Building this site, which is either ironic or appropriate. Remembering the joy of PCB layouts and initial board bringup and a flashing red LED. **Day job:** CTO and co-founder at LibertiTec, building privacy infrastructure for organisations with a duty of care to the people whose data they collect.

sections.title: Reading
sections.text: *Careless People* by Sarah Wynn-Williams — insider account of Facebook that Meta tried hard to bury, which is reason enough. *Manufacturing Consent* by Herman and Chomsky — the classic analysis of how power shapes the news. *Disgrace* by J.M. Coetzee — finally. Bleak and beautifully spare.

sections.title: Listening to
sections.text: *Evolver* by Chris Liebing. *Mezzanine* by Massive Attack. Beatport Top 100 — Today. *Sprinting Gazelle: Palestinian Songs from the Motherland and the Diaspora* by Reem Kelani — the British-Palestinian singer and researcher's 2006 debut, traditional songs and settings of poetry, and a thoughtful way into the repertoire.

sections.title: Where
sections.text: Liverpool — back from a sunny winter in Umhlanga Rocks. Planning a Lisbon trip early Autumn for a consulting gig. And ... maybe Cape Town for BSides early December.

sections.title: On my mind
sections.text: Investigating DHH's latest wonder — Omarchy. Finally getting to use my DGX Spark with Deepseek 4 Flash and Qwen-3.8-27B. Much to my immense shame becoming a bit of a fan of SuperGrok — don't judge me!
